name: Active Directory Domain Authentication Failure
checks: Confirm the client is using the expected AD DNS servers and has valid IP/gateway configuration.
Confirm the client can resolve the AD domain/domain controller names.
Confirm network reachability to the relevant domain controller.
Then inspect secure-channel, time synchronization, account state and trust errors.
stop_condition: Stop when DNS, DC reachability, time/account state, or secure-channel evidence explains the logon failure.
resolution: Correct the isolated dependency or trust problem; avoid rejoining the domain until simpler dependencies are verified.
